answer: Agents must bond stake to a jade token registry whose inductive invariant proof binds each identity to one verified key, so sybils cannot wander across aliases undetected. A karst-like partition-tolerant sync layer replicates that proof across consensus epochs, forcing any forged registration to collide with the checked invariant before finality. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
